findings.subject: Security characterization disclosure state
findings.correction: Mechanism details present in public ancestor commits and public Actions artifacts are treated as disclosed. The current audit must not describe that material as owner-private or confidential merely because the final tree deletes the scripts. Current public audit text intentionally does not repeat exploit details. Provider handling remains routed through Oteryn-Platform SECURITY.md private vulnerability reporting.
findings.artifact_deletion: NOT_ESTABLISHED; treat any historical artifact as public while it remains downloadable or its deletion/expiry has not been independently verified

findings.subject: Original browser failure recount
findings.correction: verify_r3_evidence.py parses the original browser result, requires the exact 48-case matrix, exactly eight stored http_ok failures for /support and /legal/privacy across four viewports, no hidden ninth failure, the exact 404/200 status split, clean browser observations and the recorded no-JavaScript login control. The Node replay is explicitly legacy/offline and not a new browser execution.

findings.subject: Migration execution recount
findings.correction: verify_r3_evidence.py binds migrations.log to r3-migration-review.json, reconstructs the exact 50 database/migrations/*.php path/blob set from coverage-review.tsv, validates its committed digest, then requires exactly 50 unique DONE migration names equal to that source set. Down/current-data/production migration qualification remains unclaimed.

findings.subject: Committed results drift
findings.correction: The raw-archive recount now loads r3-native-results.json and fails closed on any semantic difference from the recomputed summary.

findings.subject: Collector diagnostic overwrite
findings.correction: collect_ci_cohort.py creates both normal output and collection-error.json with exclusive binary creation. Existing files and final-path symlinks are not overwritten/followed; dedicated negative tests preserve the original target bytes.
